name: The Blank
text: No page governs here. Reality holds by habit alone.

name: Edict of the Hearth
text: Here, warmth is owed to all who shelter. Wounds close; hostile things cannot cross the threshold.

name: Edict of Kindling
text: Here, fire is hungry. Flames spread twice as fast and bite deeper.

name: Edict of Return
text: Here, the dead do not stay down. Unharvested echoes rise again. Healing is halved.

name: Edict of Rising Ash
text: Here, ash falls upward — back toward the sky it came from.
